component.name: PipeWire Matrix Router
component.summary: Route one stereo source to several PipeWire outputs at their own sample rates

description.p: PipeWire Matrix Router captures a 48 kHz stereo virtual sink and renders it to every enabled output, resampling to each device's own rate. Each output has independent volume, mute, and extra delay. The window shows an output table, stereo meters with peak hold, a 16-band spectrum, and a balance bar.
The router runs as a normal user process. It moves the default sink to its hub, restores the previous default on a clean exit, and unloads only the modules it created.
